agent_types.SensorAgent: Collects environmental data and reports it to relevant agents, serving as the eyes and ears of the system to inform decision-making.
agent_types.DecisionMakerAgent: Analyzes information from various sources to make informed decisions and direct the actions of other agents based on predefined goals.
agent_types.ExecutorAgent: Carries out the specific tasks or actions as instructed by the DecisionMakerAgent, implementing the strategies determined by the system.
agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Responsible for orchestrating interactions between various agents in the system, ensuring that tasks are completed efficiently and in a timely manner.
